title: LandlordGuard Inspection and Cure Periods
content:
Service standards for the underwriting inspection on a new LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy and for curing its findings, per tier.

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inspection ordered on every new policy | exterior | exterior | exterior | exterior | exterior and interior | exterior and interior |
| Days after binding within which the inspection is ordered (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days after the inspection completion date to cure a finding (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 | 60 |
| Days added by the one cure extension a letter may receive (calendar days) | 0 (no extension) | 15 | 15 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| New business period from the first effective date (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

## Notes

- LandlordGuard DP-3 Premier and DP-3 Portfolio receive an exterior and interior inspection; the other tiers receive an exterior inspection.
- A cure extension figure of 0, as on LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic, means no extension is available on that tier.
- The new business period is the window, counted from the first effective date, during which the policy may be cancelled for an uncured condition.

## Hypothetical illustration

An inspection completed on a hypothetical LandlordGuard DP-3 Special gives a cure period of 45 calendar days after the completion date; with the tier's one extension of 15 days, the cure due date would move 15 days later. On LandlordGuard DP-3 Premier the same figures are 60 and 30 days.
